title: EvalAreas
description: The roll-up of EvalResults into the four product areas of the HAR-145 Ghost Eval Control Plane: eval_type -> registry family (E1-E22) -> area. The instance is contracts/evals/eval_areas.json. Every EvalResult eval type maps to exactly one family, every E family to exactly one area; M1-M5 are metrics and belong to no area. Cross-references to eval_registry.json and eval_result.v1.json are tested in Go (internal/contracts, internal/evalarea).

metric_families.description: Operational diagnostics: served as OperationalMetrics, never counted as eval verdicts.

family_spans.description: E family -> the TraceSpan kind (episode_trace.v1.json) its EvalResults are attached to. A family absent here has no span of its own.

eval_types.description: EvalResult eval_type -> its primary registry family.

families.description: May be empty: Cliff / Experience holds the messages, which no eval family judges.
